text:
lia-support: heads-up: multiple customers hitting 5xx from hosted inference around 15:22 UTC. lots of `502` and `503` gateway responses. request ids: req_9a1f, req_9a23, req_9a2b.

lia-support: stack traces point to control-plane dependency timeouts (session-cache and routing-policy). errors in logs: `timeout waiting for configdb` and `invalid session lookup -> upstream 504`.

lia-support: repro steps i used: curl -> POST /v1/generate with small payload, get 502 within ~300ms. happens across regions (us-west/us-east). customers report increased latency prior to the 5xx spike.

jorge-sre: looking now. I see a short window of elevated latencies from control-plane connectors at 15:20-15:26. tracing shows increased tail latency on `session-store` kv calls. correlating with a rolling config push?

priya-platform: there was a canary config rollout started at 15:18 by the config-deploy pipeline — deploy-bot shows job 7542 succeeded at 15:19. tagging @deploy-bot for details.

deploy-bot: deploy job 7542: config-publish to control-plane completed. affected services: routing-policy, session-store-proxy. no rollback triggered. logs: publish latency peaked at 15:20:10 -> 1.2s.

mei-support: customer impact: two enterprise tenants saw repeated token refresh failures (401 -> then 502 chain). sent them an interim mitigation: switch their requests to dedicated fallback region, awaiting confirmation.

jorge-sre: quick mitigation options: 1) throttle config-read fanout on control-plane to reduce parallel KV bursts, 2) increase session-store client retry/backoff, 3) temporarily pin routing-policy to stable revision. Can someone trigger a canary rollback?

priya-platform: rolling rollback now for config-publish 7542 to previous stable. ETA ~6m. also enabling slower fanout mode on control-plane mapper to reduce storm.

dan-prodops: notify CS + impacted tenants (we have a partial template). Mei, can you send the update with ETA and suggested workaround (use dedicated/fallback region)?

mei-support: on it. pinging affected customers now with details and temporary mitigation steps.

jorge-sre: after rollback started we see error rate tapering at 15:30. still seeing a handful of timeouts for older sessions. I'll open a follow-up incident ticket to root cause the fanout behavior and session-cache eviction.

lia-support: thanks — please include the sample curl and request ids above in the incident. mark severity P1 for customers still experiencing 5xx.

priya-platform: filing postmortem draft. initial hypothesis: config rollout caused concurrent heavy reads against config DB and session kv, triggering connection pool exhaustion and increased latencies -> control-plane returned 5xx to gateway. recommended platform changes: staged fanout, circuit-breaker on config reads, larger connection pool for session-store on short term.

dan-prodops: cross-check billing impact for affected tenants (possible retry storms). Mei — capture any billing spikes in your notes.

lia-support: closing loop: customers notified, rollback in progress, error rates dropping. will update thread when postmortem link is ready. :white_check_mark:
